attributes.storage_note: Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed after each use to prevent leakage or contamination. Avoid exposing the oil to excessive heat or moisture. Do not refrigerate, as it may affect the natural texture of the oil. Keep out of reach of children.
